paragraphs.source_en:
Dear Jane — if this melancholy old
song suits any of your tunes or
any that humour of the moment may
dictate you are welcome to it. — Do
not say it is mine to any one even if
you think so; — indeed it is from the
torn leaf of a book out of date.
 How are you to day? & how is Williams?
 Tell him that I dreamed of nothing but
sailing & fishing up coral. Your ever
affectionate PBS. —
